_comment: ADR-037 register fragment (kcc-cti-adapter Task 3, spec REQ-007, design D5). Declares `call_event`: one row per telephony event integriq accepted from a CTI source, kept 30 days through a declared retention and then swept by OpenRegister's ArchivalRetentionTask. A row holds the caller's phone number, which is personal data, so the authorization block is the lockdown shape of 99-mail-schemas-lockdown.json: four EMPTY rule lists deny everyone except the `admin` group and an object's owner. CallEventLog writes and reads in system context (`_rbac: false`); the CTI webhook has no session and the agent who pushes a contact moment holds `kiss.push`, not admin. `destroy` is deliberately not listed (see 99-payment-intent-lockdown.json). Also adds `callId`, `callSourceId` and `durationSeconds` to `kiss_klantcontact`: the local mirror of a contact moment the agent recorded for a call. The VNG Klantinteracties klantcontact has no duration field, so the duration lives on the mirror and is not sent on the wire. Does NOT edit lib/Settings/integriq_register.json.

call_event.title: Call event
call_event.summary: A telephony event from a CTI source, kept 30 days
call_event.description: One row per call event a CTI source delivered: ringing, answered, ended or transferred. An agent records a contact moment for an ended call by its callId; nothing creates one by itself. Rows are dropped 30 days after they were written. See openspec/changes/kcc-cti-adapter/design.md D5.

callId.description: The PBX's identifier for the call. Every event of one call carries the same callId.
callId.title: Call id

callerNumber.description: The caller's number in E.164, or empty when the number was withheld or could not be placed.
callerNumber.title: Caller number

sourceId.description: The CTI source the event came through.
sourceId.title: Source

agentId.description: The agent the call was for, or empty.
agentId.title: Agent

at.description: When the PBX says it happened, ISO 8601, or empty.
at.title: At

durationSeconds.description: How long the call lasted. 0 except on an ended event.
durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)

callId.description: The call this contact moment was recorded for, when an agent recorded it from a CTI call.
callId.title: Call id

callSourceId.description: The CTI source of that call. One callId on two sources is two calls.
callSourceId.title: Call source

durationSeconds.description: How long the call lasted, when the contact moment was recorded for a CTI call.
durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
